transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling incredibly depressed and sad for about 10 months now. There is just this constant, heavy emptiness inside me that I can't seem to shake. I feel completely drained and hollow.
Have you had any period of at least two months during these 10 months when you felt back to your usual self, or has it been present most of the time without much relief?
No, I haven't had any relief at all. It has been completely continuous, every single day for the past 10 months. I haven't felt like my usual self even for a moment.
Do you also have low energy, poor sleep, low appetite or overeating, low self-esteem, or trouble concentrating most days?

No, I don't really have those issues. My sleep, appetite, and energy levels seem okay, and I don't have trouble concentrating or feel particularly low self-esteem. It's really just the constant sadness and emptiness that I'm dealing with.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or is it mainly the sadness and emptiness?

Yes, I have completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to enjoy, and absolutely nothing brings me pleasure anymore. I am still constantly carrying that heavy sadness and a deep sense of emptiness inside, too. It just feels like there is nothing left in me.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 years when you felt depressed or down most of the time, even if it wasn’t always as severe as it is now?
No, I've never had a period of depression that lasted for two years. These feelings of deep sadness and emptiness actually started about 10 months ago, and it has been constant since then.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 years when you felt depressed or down most of the time, even if it wasn’t always as severe as it is now?
No, I have never felt this way for two years. This heavy depression and sadness only started about 10 months ago, and it has been constant since then.
Based on what you've told me, the most likely diagnosis is Major Depressive Disorder.

That makes sense, as I've felt extremely sad, empty, and unmotivated for the last 10 months. But does this diagnosis also explain the strange things I've been seeing, hearing, and believing? Those unusual experiences only ever happen when I am going through these deep depressive episodes.
When you have those unusual experiences, are they only present during your depressive episodes, and do they go away when your mood improves?
Yes, that's exactly right. Those voices and strange beliefs only happen when I am feeling this deeply depressed. Whenever my mood starts to improve, those experiences completely disappear.
